summary: throukit.evals is now one engine built from throu's harness: suites, repeated trials, pass bars, a hard spend cap per run and across runs, reports and a CLI, with scorers and evaluate() on top. Review closed the holes where Ctrl-C or a failing pricer let a run keep spending.
why: throu had the real harness and the framework's own module was weaker and unused, so moving part of it would add code nothing calls.
